title: FeddVanish
description: Vanish for player on your server
body:
FeddVanish
A lightweight and robust vanish plugin for Paper 1.20.6+, designed for seamless administrator invisibility.

🌟 Features:
Complete Invisibility: Completely hides players from others on the server.

TAB Integration: Automatically removes your name from the player list (TabList).

Mob Ignorance: Hostile mobs will not target or follow you while in vanish.

Radar Protection: Uses metadata to ensure you are hidden from plugins like NearManager.

Actionbar Status: Stay informed with a customizable actionbar message while vanished.

Self-View: You remain visible to yourself (normal mode), making it easier to interact with the world than in Spectator mode.

Full Customization: Edit all messages and colors in the config.yml.

🛠 Commands:
/vanish (alias: /v) — Toggle vanish mode.

🔑 Permissions:
feddvanish.use — Permission to use the vanish command. (Default: OP).
